facts.en: Completed a diploma in urban horticulture at Fictional Willowstep College in 2024-06.
facts.zh: 2024-06 在虚构柳阶学院完成城市园艺文凭课程。

facts.en: The diploma field course covered leaf-key identification, tree measurement and recording visible damage; the course did not confer an arborist credential.
facts.zh: 该文凭的实地课程涵盖叶片检索表鉴定、树木测量及可见损伤记录；课程不授予树艺师资格。

facts.en: Worked as a paid seasonal grounds assistant at Fictional Northfern Park Trust from 2024-07 to 2024-11.
facts.zh: 2024-07 至 2024-11 在虚构北蕨公园信托机构任有薪季节性园务助理。

facts.en: Kept tool sign-out sheets and watering-round records during that grounds season.
facts.zh: 在该园务工作季维护工具借还表及浇水巡回记录。

facts.en: Held paid tree-inventory assistant contracts with Fictional Northfern Park Trust from 2025-04 to 2025-10 and from 2026-03 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2025-04 至 2025-10 及 2026-03 至 2026-09 在虚构北蕨公园信托机构担任有薪合同制树木清查助理。

facts.en: Recorded tag numbers, handheld GPS readings and trunk diameters on a mobile form while paired with a senior inventory worker.
facts.zh: 与一名资深清查人员结对，使用移动表单记录挂牌编号、手持 GPS 读数及树干直径。

facts.en: Measured diameter at the protocol height of 1.3 m and recorded the alternative measurement height when a fork or obstruction prevented that measurement.
facts.zh: 按规程在 1.3 米高度测量直径；分叉或障碍物妨碍该测量时，记录替代测量高度。

facts.en: 7 provisional common-name labels in the 2026 field log remained awaiting an arborist identification check when the contract ended.
facts.zh: 2026 年合同结束时，现场日志中的 7 个暂定俗名标签仍待树艺师核实鉴定。

facts.en: Photographed visible trunk damage and attached the photograph number to the tree record; the arborist determined risk ratings and work priorities.
facts.zh: 拍摄可见树干损伤并将照片编号附于树木记录；风险评级及作业优先级由树艺师确定。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet filters and conditional formatting to locate duplicate tag numbers and blank measurement units.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选及条件格式查找重复挂牌编号与缺失的测量单位。

facts.en: For the 2026 east-loop inventory, personally entered 128 observation rows; the three-person field team entered 386 rows altogether.
facts.zh: 在 2026 年东环线清查中，个人录入 128 行观察记录；三人现场团队合计录入 386 行。

facts.en: The 386 observation rows referred to 356 distinct tree tags, with 30 rows documenting repeat visits rather than additional trees.
facts.zh: 386 行观察记录涉及 356 个不同树木挂牌编号，其中 30 行记录复访，并非新增树木。

facts.en: Personally compared the east-loop form export with tag photographs and prepared a list of 12 mismatched tag entries for supervisor review.
facts.zh: 个人将东环线表单导出数据与挂牌照片对照，整理出 12 条挂牌编号不符记录供主管审核。

facts.en: The supervisor authorized register corrections; the candidate entered the authorized changes and retained the original field-note references.
facts.zh: 主管批准登记册更正；候选人录入获批变更并保留原始现场笔记引用。

facts.en: Explained the purpose of tree tags to park visitors in English and Mandarin and referred tree-removal requests to the park office.
facts.zh: 用英语和普通话向公园游客解释树木挂牌用途，并将移除树木的请求转交公园办公室。

facts.en: Can open QGIS layers, inspect attribute values and export a map from an existing layout; has not built a spatial database.
facts.zh: 能够打开 QGIS 图层、查看属性值并从现有布局导出地图；尚未建立过空间数据库。

facts.en: Made a personal illustrated leaf notebook in 2025 using fallen leaves collected where collection was permitted.
facts.zh: 2025 年制作个人图解叶片笔记本，素材为在允许采集的地点收集的落叶。

facts.en: Volunteers monthly at Fictional Juniper Shelf Seed Library, sorting donated seed envelopes by the donor-provided growing season.
facts.zh: 每月在虚构杜松架种子图书馆做志愿者，按捐赠者标注的生长季分类种子信封。

facts.en: Enjoys linocut printing of garden tools and playing informal badminton.
facts.zh: 爱好刻印园艺工具主题的油毡版画及休闲羽毛球。

facts.en: Joined the daily weather and route briefing and followed the crew lead's decision to stop measurements during unsafe weather.
facts.zh: 参加每日天气与路线简报，并遵从班组负责人在不安全天气下停止测量的决定。
